prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1490; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the impact. Initial examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion, while neurological screening and several orthopedic provocative tests were within normal limits. Over the course of 25 office visits, the patient received manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Care followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and range of motion recovered. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to the treating office. Billed services reflect one charge per visit without duplicate entries. At discharge the patient reported residual mild stiffness with good functional tolerance for daily activities and was instructed to continue a self-directed home exercise program.
